facts.basis: the plate away from its held corners

sentences: By the Tsai-Hill criterion the laminate holds at the applied loading, in the plate away from its held corners: the first ply to fail would be ply 4 (90 degrees), tied with ply 5, at element 11 (15.62, 15.62 mm), in the coupon, by the combined stresses (no single component governs), at 1.681 times every applied load (16810 N; failure index 0.5948).

By the maximum stress criterion the laminate holds at the applied loading, in the plate away from its held corners: the first ply to fail would be ply 4 (90 degrees), tied with ply 5, at element 7 (15.62, 9.375 mm), in the coupon, by tension across the fibres (sigma_2 reaching F2t, a matrix-dominated mode), at 1.721 times every applied load (17210 N; failure index 0.5811).
The earliest of the criteria is Tsai-Hill.

Outside the plate away from its held corners, Tsai-Hill is reached earlier, at 1.678 times every applied load, at element 1, in the coupon: beside a held corner, where a held edge meets a free one and the stress grows as the mesh is refined, so it is reported apart from the answer.
The plate is read at least 6.25 mm from each held corner, a quarter of its width, the same distance on every mesh.
Plate, [45/0/-45/90]s, under a force of 10000 N along y: the supports carries 10000 N, pushing along -y.
The largest displacement is 1.122 mm at node 205 (25, 250 mm), mostly along the coupon.

In the plate away from its held corners, each ply in its own fibre axes: the largest tension along the fibres (sigma_1) is 740 MPa in ply 2 (0 degrees) at element 11 (15.62, 15.62 mm); the largest compression along the fibres (sigma_1) is -224.4 MPa in ply 4 (90 degrees) at element 15 (15.62, 21.87 mm); the largest tension across the fibres (sigma_2) is 37.22 MPa in ply 4 (90 degrees) at element 7 (15.62, 9.375 mm); the largest compression across the fibres (sigma_2) is -0.2124 MPa in ply 2 (0 degrees) at element 15 (15.62, 21.87 mm); the largest in-plane shear (tau_12) is -28.13 MPa in ply 1 (45 degrees) at element 11 (15.62, 15.62 mm); these are element centroids in the ply's axes.
